basic_details.job_title: CTUAP Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.short_information: Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh (CTUAP), Vizianagaram, needs 2 project staff in its Department of Biotechnology for the NHRP project "Development of an optimal model for sickle cell disease screening, diagnosis, treatment and care: An implementation research study". The posts are 1 Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) (UR) at Rs. 56,000/- + HRA as admissible per month and 1 Project Technical Support-III (OBC) at Rs. 28,000/- + HRA, as admissible per month. Both are temporary, with an initial appointment of six months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. Appl

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format, Annexure-I (Form of Application), attached to the notice, writing the post applied for at the top.
Paste a recent photo on the form and attach proof of date of birth, as the form asks.

Fill in educational qualifications in chronological order from matriculation, all previous and present employment, and details of publications (title, authors, journal, year, volume, DOI, indexing such as Scopus/WoS/UGC Care).
Sign the declaration with place, date, name, address and mobile number.
Scan the application form and the relevant certificates (academics and experience).
Send the soft copy to [email protected] only, so that it reaches on or before 20 November 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

A separate application in the prescribed format must be sent for each post, through separate emails. If only one email is sent for various posts, only the first mentioned post will be considered for screening for interview.
Application form in Annexure-I format with a recent photo
important_instructions: Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification. Applicants are advised to visit the university website www.ctuap.ac.in regularly for any updates and changes in the recruitment process. Under the declaration, false or incorrect information at any stage makes the candidature or appointment liable to be cancelled or terminated without notice or compensation.

content_sections.heading: CTUAP Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh (CTUAP)
NHRP Project "Development of an optimal model for sickle cell disease screening, diagnosis, treatment and care: An implementation research study" (ICMR-NHRP-SAHAY Project)
Dr Parikipandla Sridevi, Associate Professor, Dept. of Biotechnology, CTUAP
Six months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier; may be extended
Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical); Project Technical Support-III
Rs. 56,000/- + HRA and Rs. 28,000/- + HRA per month respectively
Maximum 35 years (relaxable by 3 years for OBC for Project Technical Support-III)
Tribal areas of Alluri Seetharama Raju (ASR) district, Andhra Pradesh

content_sections.heading: About CTUAP
content_sections.text: Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh functions from its Transit Campus at Cantonment, Vizianagaram-535003, Andhra Pradesh. This recruitment is for the ICMR-NHRP-SAHAY Project run by the Department of Biotechnology under Principal Investigator Dr Parikipandla Sridevi. The project studies an optimal model for sickle cell disease screening, diagnosis, treatment and care in tribal areas.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: *Age relaxable by 3 years for OBC. The notice also states that OBC, SC, ST and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Professionals with Post-Graduation in Anthropology/ Social Work/ Sociology / Public Health/ Social Welfare and Rural Management/Rural Development or any other subject of life sciences. Experience: a minimum of two (02) years of post-qualification experience exclusively in community-based health research with publications. Age: maximum 35 years. Essential qualification: MA/MSc in Anthropology/ Social Work/MPH/ Social Welfare and Rural Management/Rural Development other social sciences, or life sciences, with experience in community-based health research. Alternatively: Graduates in Nursing/Dental Sciences with three years of experience in community-based health research. Age: maximum 35 years, relaxable by 3 years for OBC. Telugu speaking candidates will be preferred as the field area is in Andhra Pradesh. Qualifications and experience should be from recognised organisations with valid certificates. All the project staff should stay in the tribal area of Alluri Seetharama Raju (ASR) district. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical): Rs. 56,000/- per month + HRA as admissible. Project Technical Support-III: Rs. 28,000/- per month + HRA, as admissible. The initial appointment will be for a period of six months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. The post may be extended for a further period based on satisfactory performance and project requirements. Benefits of provident fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim, etc. are not applicable. The posts are purely temporary, and the selected candidates will have no claim for regular appointments under ICMR or in the Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh, or for continuation of their services in any other project.

content_sections.heading: CTUAP Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one job description for all the project staff, covering both posts: The project involves extensive fieldwork in the tribal areas of Alluri Seetharama Raju (ASR) district of Andhra Pradesh. All the staff should stay in the tribal area for coordination with the Govt. health system, data collection, sensitisation and community mobilisation activities. Working with the Govt. health system and collecting data regarding the national sickle cell disease mission from Primary Health Centres and Health & Wellness Centres in tribal areas. Conducting trainings and sensitization programs in the health facilities and the community.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CTUAP Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format, Annexure-I (Form of Application), attached to the notice, writing the post applied for at the top. Paste a recent photo on the form and attach proof of date of birth, as the form asks. Fill in educational qualifications in chronological order from matriculation, all previous and present employment, and details of publications (title, authors, journal, year, volume, DOI, indexing such as Scopus/WoS/UGC Care). Sign the declaration with place, date, name, address and mobile number. Scan the application form and the relevant certificates (academics and experience). Send the soft copy to [email protected] only, so that it reaches on or before 20 November 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered. A separate application in the prescribed format must be sent for each post, through separate emails. If only one email is sent for various posts, only the first mentioned post will be considered for screening for interview. Application form in Annexure-I format with a recent photo Proof of date of birth Scanned copies of academic certificates Scanned copies of experience certificates

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates should bring all necessary original documents and copies to the interview. All original certificates, including educational qualification and experience certificates, must be produced for verification in case of appointment. No TA, DA, etc. will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CTUAP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) (UR) and 1 Project Technical Support-III (OBC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CTUAP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The soft copy of the application must reach [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026; applications received later will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CTUAP Project Research Scientist-I post?
faq.answer: Post-Graduation in Anthropology/ Social Work/ Sociology / Public Health/ Social Welfare and Rural Management/Rural Development or any other subject of life sciences, with at least two years of post-qualification experience exclusively in community-based health research with publications.

faq.question: Q4. Can nursing graduates apply for Project Technical Support-III at CTUAP?
faq.answer: Yes. Graduates in Nursing/Dental Sciences with three years of experience in community-based health research are eligible, as are MA/MSc holders in the listed subjects or life sciences with community-based health research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CTUAP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for both posts; for Project Technical Support-III it is relaxable by 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for CTUAP project posts?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) gets Rs. 56,000/- per month and Project Technical Support-III gets Rs. 28,000/- per month, each plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA as admissible is paid over the monthly remuneration, but provident fund, Leave Travel Concession and Medical Claim benefits are not applicable.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for CTUAP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-I application form with scanned academic and experience certificates to [email protected] only, before 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CTUAP project posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on eligibility, and only shortlisted candidates are called for interview through email; no TA or DA is paid for attending.

faq.question: Q10. Is the CTUAP project job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary, for six months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier, and may be extended based on satisfactory performance and project requirements.
